services.desc: Find up-to-date site availability for this campground through a partner site. Availability may be limited. This Campground is kind of in the middle of nowhere in a little town called Rockyford. You can walk to the downtown area and there are a couple of restaurants that look like they are open. The campground has water and power and a dump. There are a few full-time residents on one side of the park. It's quiet, and easy to get to. blurb: We just headed to the Drumheller area on a Saturday night and ended up staying in this campground. Walking distance from the Last Chance Saloon and if you hike up the badlands behind the campground , you get a nice view of the surrounding area . Free WiFi and dry toilets, which are very clean .
